properties.title: Chorabari Moraine Breach & Debris Torrent
properties.description: Glacial outburst surge has carved dual channels flanking temple. Structural perimeter compromise. Ground evacuation severed.
properties.action: Immediate rotary extraction from northern bedrock knoll when weather allows.

properties.title: Rambara Gorge Total Transit Interruption
properties.description: Narrow gorge inundated by debris flow velocity >12 m/s. All footpaths severed. Stranded clusters on upper scree slopes.
properties.action: Airborne food & medicine drops; guide mobile survivors to high ridges.

properties.title: Sonprayag Confluence Bridge Washout
properties.description: Songanga-Mandakini convergence has washed away motor bridge. 1,600+ pilgrims blocked on upstream bank.
properties.action: Deploy NDRF zip-line / rope rescue crossings; establish temporary foot suspension bridge.
